endorsements.name: Fermin J. Serna
endorsements.label: The Info Leak Era on Software Exploitation
endorsements.description:
Previously, and mainly due to application compatibility. ASLR has not been as effective as it has been expected. Nowadays, once some of the
problems to fully deploy ASLR has been solved, it has become the key mitigation preventing reliable exploitation of software vulnerabilities. Defeating ASLR is a hot topic in the exploitation world.
